# ARC Raiders Skill Tree Builder

ARC Raiders Skill Tree Builder is a free, community-created planner for allocating skill points across Conditioning, Mobility, and Survival. It includes an AI Build Advisor, build sharing, skill references, and practical guides for ARC Raiders players.

This site is not affiliated with or endorsed by Embark Studios. Skill values and game information may change after updates.

## Tools

- [Interactive Skill Tree Builder](https://arcraiderskill.com/): Plan skill ranks, inspect prerequisites, track branch totals, share builds, and capture screenshots
- [AI Build Advisor](https://arcraiderskill.com/): Generate a personalized build or review a current allocation using point budget, squad size, focus, playstyle, and optional priorities
- [AI See](https://arcraiderskill.com/ai-see.html): Machine-readable overview of the site's capabilities, skill-tree structure, data notes, and citation routes

## Skill tree resources

- [Wiki and quick reference](https://arcraiderskill.com/wiki.html): Skill-tree concepts, branch summaries, unlock requirements, and planning guidance
- [Skill Tree Builder Guide](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/arc-raiders-skill-tree-builder-guide.html): Instructions for allocating points, sharing builds, and using the AI Build Advisor
- [Skill Tree Mechanics Deep Dive](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/skill-tree-mechanics-deep-dive.html): Detailed explanation of prerequisites, branch requirements, ranks, and point allocation
- [Best Skill Tree Build](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/arc-raiders-skill-tree-best-build.html): General build priorities and allocation strategy
- [Skill Tree Builds](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/arc-raiders-skill-tree-builds.html): Build archetypes for different roles and playstyles
- [PvP Skill Tree Build](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/arc-raiders-pvp-skill-tree-build.html): Mobility and combat priorities for player-versus-player encounters

## Branch guides

- [Conditioning Guide](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/ultimate-conditioning-guide.html): Conditioning skills, stamina management, durability, and branch synergies
- [Mobility Guide](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/mobility-mastery-guide.html): Movement, traversal, repositioning, and Mobility-focused builds
- [Survival Guide](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/survival-branch-complete-guide.html): Looting, inventory, resource management, and Survival-focused builds

## Beginner and gameplay guides

- [Beginner Guide 2026](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/arc-raiders-beginner-guide-2026.html): Core systems, loadouts, skill trees, extraction, and early progression
- [Beginner Mistakes](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/arc-raiders-beginner-mistakes.html): Common early-game mistakes and how to correct them
- [Extraction Loop Guide](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/arc-raiders-extraction-loop-guide.html): Preparation, in-raid decisions, extraction timing, and run profitability
- [Survival Tips](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/arc-raiders-survival-tips.html): Practical tactics for surviving raids and extracting consistently
- [PvP Combat Tactics](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/arc-raiders-pvp-combat-tactics.html): Positioning, sound, engagement decisions, and player combat strategy
- [High-Risk Zones Guide](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/arc-raiders-high-risk-zones-guide.html): Risk assessment, loot strategy, retreat planning, and hot-zone survival

## Weapon guides

- [Weapon Guide Index](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog.html): Browse all weapon, build, gameplay, and update articles
- [Anvil Guide](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/arc-raiders-anvil-guide.html): Anvil stats, tactics, loadouts, and skill-tree pairings
- [Ferro Guide](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/arc-raiders-ferro-guide.html): Ferro stats, combat roles, and recommended builds
- [Osprey Guide](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/arc-raiders-osprey-guide.html): Beginner sniper tactics, stats, and skill-tree pairings
- [Renegade vs. Venator](https://arcraiderskill.com/blog/arc-raiders-renegade-vs-venator.html): Side-by-side comparison for choosing between the two weapons
